question: A can complete a piece of work in 90 days. B is 75% less efficient than A. C is 80% more efficient than B. If B and C work together for 30 days, A alone will complete the remaining work in:
solution:
**Given:**

A’s efficiency = 1/90

B’s efficiency = 25% of A

C’s efficiency = 180% of B

Time of B and C together = 30 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Total Work = LCM of times

Time = Work ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

&
